<?php
/**
 * Plugin Name: Example Load Order
 */
// Shapes a real-install scan found F23 firing on when it was case-insensitive:
// Akismet, Freemius and Gravity Perks all talk about active_plugins in prose
// and write it through the options API. None of this is raw SQL.

/**
 * Update the plugin loading order. Anytime the active_plugins option
 * changes, move this plugin to the front of the list.
 */
function example_load_first( $plugins ) {
	$self = plugin_basename( __FILE__ );
	if ( $plugins && $plugins[0] !== $self ) {
		array_unshift( $plugins, $self );
		update_option( 'active_plugins', array_values( array_unique( $plugins ) ) );
	}
	return $plugins;
}

// Changelog, 2.1: UPDATE: handle active_plugins on multisite. (Capital
// UPDATE, no SET: only the SET shape stops this one.)
// Hooks run when we update the set of active_plugins. (update ... set in
// lower case: only case-sensitivity stops this one.)

// Update SDK info for the newest version: stored under its own key.
update_option( 'fs_active_plugins', (object) array( 'newest' => '2.6.0' ) );

function example_row( $file ) {
	$update = in_array( $file, (array) get_option( 'active_plugins', array() ), true );
	return '<tr class="plugin-update-tr" data-update="' . ( $update ? 1 : 0 ) . '"></tr>';
}
